text: Superficial identifiers such as language, race, culture, social media profiles, and credit scores play less of a role in DAO of DAOs voting design, which allows inclusion of constituents who have no agency in centralized systems.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3799320

isBasedOn.name: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs

abstract: Such relatively superficial identifiers play less of a role in the DAO of DAOs voting designs. The more equal distribution of power in the DAO of DAOs governance design allows the inclusion of constituents who otherwise have no agency in centralized systems.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: reputation based voting rather than identity based access
